decisions.reason: The cross-Requirement impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, which updates the bushing's shaft relationship and retention method and removes the obsolete POS 4 and guided-component attributes.
The revised bushing arrangement does not necessarily change any specified main-shaft dimension, stock, keyway, thread, or bushing-space width.
The bushing guidance and retention change does not alter the established premachining, welding, or final-machining sequence.
The source changes the bushing's arrangement but does not change its CuSn12 material or any other material specification.
The bushing arrangement is independent of the specified 45-degree angle between the lug hole axes.
Changing the modeled bushing arrangement does not change the assembly-based drawing-numbering rule.
The source supplies design content for the drawings but does not change the independent obligation to provide the manufacturing drawing set.
The source changes a mechanical configuration represented in the model, but it does not change the candidate's current requirement to deliver a 3D assembly model.
The revised bushing configuration does not alter ČSN/EN compliance, template availability, or template-selection requirements.
The source changes the mechanical arrangement but does not independently change any current dimensioning or annotation requirement.
